question: 找出2024与2025中共同选修的学生，学期编号为1并排除退课，2025中总评最低的排名第一的学生，按两年共同课程计算总评相加不低于实际，返回学号与两年总评。
primary_label: 题目、参考或数据口径尚不能裁定
finding: 预测按题面共同课程取两年课程交集，参考仅按共同学生对两年全部课程求和。虽然初始缺2025.student结构，主要分歧是参考是否落实共同课程，不能把合理题意执行直接判为模型错。
next_validation: 人工确认共同课程定义和排名并列规则，保留当前覆盖缺口作为独立观察。

reference.question: 找出2024与2025中共同选修的学生，学期编号为1并排除退课，2025中总评最低的排名第一的学生，按两年共同课程计算总评相加不低于实际，返回学号与两年总评。
reference.query: WITH per2024 AS ( SELECT e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.student_id ), per2025 AS ( SELECT e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.student_id ), common_students AS ( SELECT p24.student_id, p24.total_score_2024, p25.total_score_2025 FROM per2024 p24 JOIN per2025 p25 ON p25.student_id = p24.student_id ) SELECT s.student_no, ROUND(c.total_score_2024, 2) AS total_score_2024, ROUND(c.total_score_2025, 2) AS total_score_2025 FROM common_students c JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = c.student_id ORDER BY c.total_score_2025 ASC, s.student_no ASC LIMIT 1;

predicted.query: WITH s2024 AS (SELECT e.student_id, e.course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.course_id), s2025 AS (SELECT e.student_id, e.course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.course_id), common AS (SELECT s2024.student_id, s2024.course_id, s2024.total_score AS total_2024, s2025.total_score AS total_2025 FROM s2024 JOIN s2025 ON s2024.student_id=s2025.student_id AND s2024.course_id=s2025.course_id), agg AS (SELECT student_id, SUM(total_2024) AS sum_2024, SUM(total_2025) AS sum_2025 FROM common GROUP BY student_id), ranked AS (SELECT student_id, sum_2024, sum_2025, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sum_2025 ASC, student_id ASC) AS rn FROM agg) SELECT st.student_no, ROUND(r.sum_2024,2) AS total_2024, ROUND(r.sum_2025,2) AS total_2025 FROM ranked r JOIN education_2025.student st ON st.student_id=r.student_id WHERE r.rn=1;

source_semantic_review: 预测先按学生+课程汇总、两年按共同课程连接再汇总，参考按各年全部课程汇总后只交集学生；还以student_id替代student_no打破并列。参考没有落实题面的共同课程限定，应记录标签疑点。

examples_in_actual_prompt.question: 比较2024与2025两年共同学生中，按学号，学期一中平均总评折算分提升最多的第一名，即2025减2024，排除退课。

steps.query: WITH per2024 AS ( SELECT e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.enrollment_id ), avg2024 AS ( SELECT student_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM per2024 GROUP BY student_id ), per2025 AS ( SELECT e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.enrollment_id ), avg2025 AS ( SELECT student_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM per2025 GROUP BY student_id ) SELECT s.student_no, ROUND(a.avg_total_2024, 2) AS avg_total_2024, ROUND(b.avg_total_2025, 2) AS avg_total_2025, ROUND(b.avg_total_2025 - a.avg_total_2024, 2) AS diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 FROM avg2024 a JOIN avg2025 b ON b.student_id = a.student_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = b.student_id ORDER BY diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 DESC, s.student_no ASC LIMIT 1;
